entities.name: Nadia Bey
entities.description: A young monster hunter in training on Innistrad, niece of Master Bey, who fights with weapons and Avacynian wards.

entities.name: Master Bey
entities.description: Nadia's uncle, an infamous hunter of darkness who tests her by staging an attack of undead in her room.

entities.name: Kasten
entities.description: Nadia's loyal hound, rescued as a puppy from an open grave in Nephalia.

entities.name: Jorgson
entities.description: One of Master Bey's men, told to load the corpses onto the wagon.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The Archangel whose name wards invoke and whose light kills the skaab.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where vampires, werewolves and undead threaten the people and faith in the angels is wavering.

entities.name: Bey Manor
entities.description: The walled, warded manor where Nadia lives and is attacked.

entities.name: Gatstaf Village
entities.description: A nearby village whose Discontents doubt the Church.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A region on whose border Nadia and Master Bey destroyed a nest of devils.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A wild region of Innistrad where wards once kept lonely cottages safe.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A region with a port town where Nadia rescued Kasten.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A place where a situation requires Master Bey and Nadia to leave.

entities.name: Avacynian Church
entities.description: The church of Avacyn whose soldiers are called cathars.

entities.name: Discontents
entities.description: Villagers of Gatstaf who voice doubts about the faith.

entities.name: Dead Cathar
entities.description: A one-eyed zombie, once a soldier of the Avacynian Church, sent against Nadia.

entities.name: Stitched Girl
entities.description: An undead skaab girl with blades stitched to her fingers.

entities.name: Giant Skaab
entities.description: The largest skaab Nadia has seen, stitched with metal loops, which almost strangles her.

events.summary: Nadia wakes in her room at Bey Manor to a metallic clinking moving down the corridor toward her door.
events.quote: Besides, the noise was moving down the corridor toward her door.

events.summary: Recalling the past, Nadia and her uncle had destroyed a nest of devils near Stensia two days earlier, leaving her wounded.
events.quote: She and her uncle—the infamous Master Bey—had destroyed a nest of devils on the border with Stensia two days earlier.

events.summary: Nadia discovers Kasten missing and her dagger gone, so someone has been in her room.
events.quote: So someone had been inside her room.

events.summary: Ghouls attack through the window and roof; Nadia kicks the first one off the sill.
events.quote: Nadia leapt across the room, kicking it in the head before it could drag itself into the room.

events.summary: Nadia finds her weapon chest padlocked and realizes her uncle staged the attack.
events.quote: Her uncle had set this up.

events.summary: Nadia fights the Dead Cathar and drops it with her quilt and a falling skaab.
events.quote: Nadia sprang off the bed and tackled the zombie, her slender frame just barely enough to upend it.

events.summary: Nadia sets Stitched Girl aflame with hot coals from the fireplace.
events.quote: The embers struck the skaab's eyes.

events.summary: Nadia finds a flask of holy water in her cloak and uses it with a ward to put out the flames, feeling Avacyn's presence.
events.quote: She felt a rush of wind, as if Avacyn's wings were beating the air itself.

events.summary: Nadia bashes Stitched Girl with the nightstand and steers it out the window.
events.quote: Too brittle and burned to fight, Stitched Girl let itself be steered to the window frame, where it tumbled into the darkness without a fight.

events.summary: A massive skaab breaks through the door, throws Nadia into the wall and chokes her.
events.quote: The skaab picked her up by her throat and flung her into the wall.

events.summary: Nadia recalls her family's deaths: her father to a werewolf, her mother to a vampire.
events.quote: Her father had died to a werewolf in the field near their house.

events.summary: Remembering her family's farm, Nadia unleashes a holy spell that destroys the giant skaab from the inside out.
events.quote: The moment she gave in to memory, energy pulsed through her body and seared her would-be murderer.

events.summary: Master Bey arrives, orders the bodies buried, and tells Nadia they leave for Thraben in an hour.
events.quote: "A messenger from Thraben arrived," he told her. "There's a situation in Thraben. We leave in an hour."

events.summary: Master Bey praises Nadia, confirming the attack was a test.

relations.quote: She and her uncle—the infamous Master Bey—had destroyed a nest of devils

relations.note: Her loyal hound, rescued by her as a puppy.
relations.quote: She had rescued him as a puppy from an open grave on the outskirts of a port town in Nephalia.
His praise was as uncommon as sunlight.
He motioned two of his men inside the room.

relations.note: The manor stands among Innistrad's people.
relations.quote: Whispers of doubt were growing louder among the people of Innistrad.
